events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today marks the 75th birthday of American-British singer, songwriter, and musician Chrissie Hynde, best known as the lead vocalist and primary songwriter of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young! Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, is celebrating her birthday today. Still delivering those powerful vocals and sharp lyrics.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, famed as the lead vocalist of Oasis and later Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice behind some of the biggest anthems of the 90s and beyond, still bringing that unmistakable swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK, promoting his compilation album 'Shaved Fish'. The track originally appeared on his 1971 album of the same name.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since 'Imagine' landed as a UK single! John Lennon's powerful message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago, on October 23, 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: Tech Throwback
angles.copy: Remember life before streaming? It's 25 years since the original iPod dropped, changing music forever. How many songs could you fit on yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 64 years of 007. Which Bond theme tune is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday. The iconic co-founder of The Beatles was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python and star of 'Fawlty Towers', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double LP
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that pushed boundaries and still sounds incredible. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead vocalist of Queen, who died in London in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an icon. Remembering the extraordinary talent and unforgettable stage presence of Freddie Mercury. His voice still reigns supreme.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Evolution of The Beatles
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showcased their incredible growth as songwriters and musicians. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we remember John Lennon. His vision for a better world, expressed through his music, continues to echo globally. Forever missed, never forgotten.
